items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the base change formula for derived sections over etale quasi-compact opens along the derived descent tower at source lines 2816-2826, label lemma-compute-over-affine-derived, whose proof occupies source lines 2828-2850. The proof is a three stage chain: the homotopy colimit representation of sections, its application to K_n with the etale identification of U and U_n over the level, and the levelwise application of the derived perfect base change lemma with commutation of derived tensor with homotopy colimits. None of this appears in the counted statement.
